notes: Songze culture of the Lake Tai region, the later phase of the Majiabang tradition: infobox 'c. 3800 - c. 3300 BCE', 'existed between 3800 and 3300 BCE in the Lake Tai area near Shanghai'; type site in Qingpu, Shanghai; Dongshan 18 km west of Zhangjiagang; Jiangli radiocarbon 3540-3090 BCE. Extent: 'the Lake Tai area near Shanghai' only; the Majiabang shape is reused unchanged (confidence 2). The Songze page also records 'Some researchers have suggested that Songze was a successor phase to the Hemudu culture' (not followed: the Hemudu dossier keeps the south of the bay to 3300). The Liangzhu follows in 3300 (infobox and the Liangzhu page: 'Preceded by: Songze culture and Hemudu culture'). No area figure.
